concurrencyConfig.description: PARALLEL_MULTI_AGENT allows multiple agents to harvest different repositories concurrently with target-level locking and atomic rebase-retry git pushes. SINGLE_AGENT_MUTEX restricts harvesting to exactly one agent at a time.

cloudSchedule: Every 2 hours via GitHub Actions (Runs 24/7 even when laptop is closed/offline)
localSyncStrategy: Auto-pull on agent boot or IDE start (git pull --rebase origin main)
